name: ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN)
description: ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer turns the live 500K-study U.S. clinical-trials registry into a single Claude-native research surface. Ask a natural-language question — "Phase 3 oncology trials by sponsor this year", "recruiting trials within 50 miles of me", "plain-English eligibility for NCT05012345" — and Claude writes a short program that hits the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API directly, filters and joins the results, and answers. Built on a "code mode" architecture: three MCP tools instead of dozens, an indexed BM25 search over the API and field dictionary, and a sandboxed TypeScript runtime where Claude's code executes without network, filesystem, or process access. Free to use. No login. No PII collected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://clinicaltrials.mcp.blencorp.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) provides these MCP tools: search_api, describe_schema, and execute.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) in healthcare on the Manufact MCP catalog include Virtual Fly Brain, Aniva, Health Data Avatar (HDA), KORE, and PubCrawl.

_published_faq.name: Does ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN) is developed by BLEN. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
